resources.string: Made by Robotrix – The Robotics Club of GCELT
Check out RC Controller – build, connect and drive your DIY RC car over Bluetooth! Install the attached APK to get started.

Welcome to RC Controller, the official driving interface built by Robotrix – The Robotics Club of GCELT.

We built this app to bridge the gap between hardware and software. Whether you are testing a classic 4-motor chassis, a tracked tank bot, or a custom servo arm, this controller provides industrial-grade Bluetooth communication with zero-delay execution.

Featuring precision D-Pad controls, an analog vector joystick, and an advanced dual-mode gyroscope for tilt steering, we wanted to give DIY builders a tool that feels as professional as the hardware they create.

Thank you for driving with us. Keep innovating, keep building, and push the boundaries of what your robots can do.

Build. Connect. Drive.
— The Robotrix Team
